exact_blockers: No exact Media3 Java source is present or pinned. There is no Media3/AndroidX/ExoPlayer checkout, no 40-hex source revision, no SonicAudioProcessor.java or Sonic.java digest, and no reviewed LICENSE bundle for the release. The pinned research note links a documentation page and describes the candidate; it does not provide source, revision or file bytes.

No exact Media3 artifact or runtime exists. No Media3 AAR/JAR, Gradle cache, Maven cache, Java build, Android runtime image, device or emulator is present. No sample format, speed/pitch range, buffering, content delay, state or drain contract is recorded.
No pinned Java/Android build toolchain exists. No JDK, Gradle wrapper, Android Gradle Plugin, Android SDK, dependency lock or reproducible build output is recorded for the candidate.

Rights are unresolved. The rights register has no Media3, Sonic or AndroidX entry, so evaluation, redistribution, customer deployment, public playback and output use are unknown. Apache-2.0 source text is not a signed rights decision and does not clear Android platform, toolchain, corpus or output rights.

No candidate semantics or geometry are known. The pinned note says SonicAudioProcessor is an Apache-2.0 Java implementation of Sonic that supports speed and pitch; it establishes no accepted ranges, defaults, sample formats, buffering, content delay or state behaviour. This package fabricates none and exposes no provider.

The present native Sonic C original is not the candidate. cpp-library/third_party/sonic contains the Apache-2.0 Sonic C library by Bill Cox, pinned read-only for provenance. It is a different implementation from Media3's Java port, has no Media3 Android integration, and is not admitted for parity, quality or qualification.

No candidate evidence exists. There is no Media3 output, exact-reference parity, rights-cleared corpus, independent pitch, transient or preservation scorer, permitted listening result or target-runtime timing. The synthetic arithmetic control is not Media3 and cannot qualify the candidate. All eight release gates remain blocked and no result may qualify the candidate.
